TITLE: Internal Status Update for Project Kridresa

  
**Summary**  
Project Kridresa, which is built on the Barnuis Console, continues to progress as planned and remains aligned with its projected milestones. This report provides an overview of recent developments, ongoing concerns, and upcoming priorities. The project team is actively managing compliance and operational requirements, with a focus on ensuring all deliverables remain on schedule.

  
**Progress**  
Since the last reporting cycle, development for Project Kridresa has followed the planned timeline. The integration of critical system components with the Barnuis Console has been completed, and internal assessments have confirmed that the system is performing within acceptable parameters. The audit finding associated with Project Kridresa, designated as MW-6820-Z, has led to a focused review of internal documentation. The development and compliance teams have worked closely to revise and refine processes, which has resulted in the implementation of additional validation checks. This refinement has helped strengthen the project's procedural integrity and will contribute to a more robust submission during future audits. The upcoming phase of the project has commenced, with system testing in progress and planning for user acceptance testing well underway.

  
**Risks**  
Despite the current positive momentum, the project continues to monitor a few key risks. One such risk involves the pending approval of a third-party integration, which is under review by the finance lead for compliance with company procurement guidelines. While this does not currently delay the core development work, any delays in finalizing this approval could affect the scheduling of external validation testing. Another risk is the potential difficulty in securing the required technical staff for the upcoming testing phase. To mitigate this, the project team is actively identifying backup resources and adjusting timelines to maintain flexibility in staffing decisions.

  
**Next Steps**  
The primary objective for the next reporting period will be the completion of system testing and the start of user acceptance testing. The team will also continue to refine documentation to meet compliance expectations, especially in response to the audit finding related to Project Kridresa. Maintaining close collaboration with the finance lead will be essential to secure timely approval of the external integration. A mid-phase review has also been scheduled to evaluate the project’s progress and determine whether any adjustments are necessary to support continued success. The team will continue to deliver consistent updates to ensure alignment with the strategic goals of Zastama Industries.
